\mxunit{enrichment-lattice-paths-exercises}{Paths, combinations and Pascal}
\mxsubtitle{High school · counting \textperiodcentered{} Progressive exercises \textperiodcentered{} 05}

\begin{exercise}
Find $\binom{8}{2}$ and explain why it equals $\binom{8}{6}$.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
Count monotone paths from $\pt{0;0}$ to $\pt{4;3}$.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
How many of these paths pass through $\pt{2;1}$?
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
Choose a team of three from eight people. Two specified people cannot be together. How many teams remain possible?
\end{exercise}
